data.fund_type: An open-ended equity scheme following Transportation & Logistics theme.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate long-term capital appreciation from a portfolio that is invested predominantly in equity and equity related securities of companies engaged in transportation & logistics and related activities. However, there is no assurance that the objective of the scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related instruments of Transportation& Logistics and related activities -80% - 100% Equity and Equity Related securities of companies other than those engaged in Transportation & Logistics related activities- 0-20% Debt/Money Market Instruments - 0-20% Units of InvITs- 0-20% $companies include units of REITs
data.benchmark: Nifty Transportation & Logistics Index (Total Return Index (TRI)).
data.exit_load: For redemption / switch out within 90 days from the date of allotment: 0.5% If units are redeemed or switched out on or after 90 days from the date of allotment -Nil Units issued on reinvestment of IDCW shall not be subject to entry and exit load. Any exit load charged (net off Goods and Services tax, if any) shall be credited back to the Scheme.
